stycken: Your posting describes an organisation in the middle of a system change, with staff who need to understand why and managers who need support. That is exactly what I have worked on for the past five years.

At Region Uppsala I led communications for a new patient record system for 9,000 staff. I built a network of local ambassadors, produced material for dialogue meetings and measured comprehension quarterly so we could correct course in time.
I would be glad to tell you more about how I would approach your rollout. Thank you for reading.
